gw_dns.log.moved: GW repair: {detail} — moved gateway DNS to port {port}
gw_dns.no_dnsmasq: dnsmasq is missing: kaskadctl gw enable installs the {package} package.
gw_dns.not_started: Gateway DNS ({unit}) did not start: {why} — gateway clients have no DNS
gw_dns.note_old: dnsmasq {version} is older than 2.89: AAAA answers are not filtered — clients with IPv6 of their own network may bypass the tunnel
gw_dns.port_busy: port {port} on {ip} is in use: {holders} — free it
gw_dns.probe_busy: port {port} (gateway DNS) is in use: {holders} — gateway DNS won’t start until it is free
gw_dns.stale: Gateway DNS is in its old form ({what}): client queries go to port {port}, but dnsmasq may listen on 53
